offlineCounterexampleForRegression.invalidClaim: E177 是一个开源 AI agent 仓库，可以部署。
offlineCounterexampleForRegression.expected: Reject repository/open-source/deployability claims: the source is unreviewed podcast publisher metadata, not repository metadata; citation ID existence is insufficient.

limitations: No customer data, credentials, workspace capability, task IDs or private account data included.
No statistical/general model quality claim; one normal production trial task only.

executionEvidence.qaMechanism: Source-audited app.mjs line 8: __qa presence suppresses Jarvis fixed business events only; task creation does not read it or bypass quotas.
executionEvidence.initialIdentity: Existing cloud-browser anonymous workspace; visible remaining trial=1; no other tasks visible; no memory selected.
executionEvidence.finalIdentity: Same workspace; trial used; one task, completed; visible model call count 1.
executionEvidence.sourceCap: engine.mjs line 63 admits at most 14 source records before model synthesis; 6 catalog + 1 arithmetic + 4 GitHub + 3 HN. Tool log reports 4 HN returned; the fourth was not admitted, and is not known from UI/export.
executionEvidence.modelActualProviderRequest: Not independently captured. Can only reconstruct from audited code plus task input and persisted evidence; not equivalent to observing provider payload.
executionEvidence.usageFromAudit: Provider r.usage (or null) is stored in result.usage and exposed by normal authenticated tasks API. UI and Markdown export do not display it. No raw authenticated API request was made to acquire it.

trace.detail: 6 matching catalog records; metadata is not full-source review
3 allowed tool actions; fixed evidence workflow, no new planning inference
Output shape and citation identifiers checked; factual accuracy still needs source review

executionEvidence.timingInterpretation: 5.030 seconds observe→verify. Last retrieval→verify 2.582 seconds includes synthesis, quota/state handling, parsing and validation; neither is exact model-only latency. Browser UI completion polling adds separate delay.

minimalRepairRecommendations: Separate source-grounded facts from recommendations. For metadata-only scope, render names, type, URLs and attributed description directly rather than allow unsupported semantic expansion.
Carry the deterministic 3*60=180 result into the main response with units and time-budget use; do not rely on the model to remember it from a long source bundle.
Require one observable next-step artifact and a bounded timebox, e.g. within 180 minutes save the repository URL, two directly supported facts, and explicitly unknown license/deployment details.

For project-candidate tasks, enforce repository_metadata eligibility; keep podcast/editorial/HN metadata as context only. Add the actual unsupported human-centric phrase and podcast-as-repository counterexample to offline tests.
Preserve provider/model, existing trial and call limits, identity, retention and analytics suppression. Do not spend another anonymous trial just to obtain a passing screenshot.

boundaryAudit.testDataRetention: normal product retention 30 days; no task deletion attempted
